objectives: To provide students with an in-depth understanding of CSS Grid and Flexbox for advanced website layout design.
To offer hands-on experience in creating responsive, structured, and visually appealing web layouts using practical tools such as cssgridgenerator.io.
To encourage creativity and problem-solving by allowing students to work on personalized grid- based designs while receiving real-time guidance from the ACM team.
outcomes: Students developed a deeper understanding of layout styling using both Grid and Flexbox, enhancing their website design capabilities.
Participants gained practical exposure to using CSS layout tools and applying them to custom projects.
The interactive workshop format boosted student engagement and helped identify potential recruits for the ACM technical team, including candidates for the Assistant Tech Head position.
